title: Nomad Event Contract
description: Durable and ephemeral event definitions. No encryption fields. Source: CON-002, PRD 6.2, SP-01, SP-06.

event_id.description: Globally unique event identifier. Format: <session_id>:<seq> or opaque. MUST be unique within the system.

seq.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number within a Session. Gap detection: any missing seq [last_ack+1, current_seq] indicates a gap.

durable.description: This schema covers durable events only. All events MUST have durable=true. Ephemeral events (delta, typing, presence) are not part of this contract and MUST NOT be used for recovery.

payload.description: Event payload. Minimal for durable events. Encryption envelope is out of scope for CON-002.

chunk_ref.description: Reference to bounded payload stored separately (for large tool output, diff chunks).

invariants.rule: seq MUST be strictly monotonically increasing for a given session_id. No gaps are allowed in the durable event stream; gaps mean lost events.
event_id MUST be unique across all Sessions. Same event_id means same event; duplicates are idempotent.
durable MUST be true for all events in this contract. Ephemeral events are NOT part of this contract and MUST NOT be used for recovery.
If payload exceeds the bounded size limit, the event MUST set chunk_ref and payload must be null or minimal.
Receivers MUST NOT auto-persist unknown event types. Unknown event_type values are treated as protocol version mismatch and fail closed.
A delta (ephemeral) loss MUST still allow the consumer to reconstruct the final state from durable events alone.

unknown_event_strategy: Unknown event types fail closed. The receiver records the unknown type as a protocol mismatch and does not auto-persist or forward it.
